title: Fix contradictory fixed-header definition in link draft
description: Correctness review found draft-lichen-link-01.md §3.1 says PLD length is LENGTH minus fixed_header_size and then defines fixed_header_size as 4 for '(LENGTH+LLSec+EPO+SEQ)'. Those named fields total 5 octets, while the correct four body octets are LLSec+EPO+SEQ because LENGTH is excluded from its own value. Rewrite the definition unambiguously and cover PLD-length arithmetic for SI/no-SI and destination modes.
